summary: Main Django URL routing configuration for the conversationalBI project.
purpose: Serves as the central URL dispatch entry point, mapping incoming HTTP requests to the appropriate application views, sub-URL configurations, or the Django admin interface, thereby decoupling the web server's root namespace from individual app routing logic.
responsibilities: Define root URL patterns and project-level routing rules
Delegate application-specific routes to app-level URLconfs using include()
Expose the Django administrative interface via django.contrib.admin
Map URL paths to view functions or class-based views
Maintain the central URL namespace for reverse URL resolution
inputs: URL route definitions (path strings, view callables, optional kwargs/name)
Included sub-URL configurations from project apps
outputs: Resolved view callables for HTTP request handling
Routed requests to app-specific URLconfs or admin endpoints
Named URL patterns for reverse resolution across the project
architecture_notes: Implements the Front Controller pattern via Django's root URLconf. Uses declarative routing (django.urls.path) and modular delegation (django.urls.include) to enforce loose coupling between the project configuration and individual applications. Centralizing routing at backend/config/urls.py ensures a single, authoritative namespace while allowing apps to own their internal route definitions. The inclusion of django.contrib.admin suggests an operational back-office interface is exposed, which should be secured appropriately in production.
improvements: Add explicit namespace='app_name' to all include() calls to guarantee reverse URL resolution stability
Introduce API versioning prefixes (e.g., api/v1/) early if REST endpoints are planned
Define custom handler404 and handler500 at the project level for consistent error responses
Add a /health or /ready endpoint for load balancer and container orchestration health checks
Restrict or disable the admin route in production environments via environment-specific URL configurations
Document each route with inline comments explaining the owning app or business capability
